.github/dependabot.yml.name: Dependabot schedule
.github/dependabot.yml.description: Batches weekly npm minor and patch bumps and GitHub Actions SHA bumps into grouped PRs after a 7-day cooldown; ignores @types/node majors.

.github/workflows/check-undocumented-iss.name: Close empty docs requests
.github/workflows/check-undocumented-iss.description: On an opened issue titled 'Docs update request:' whose body is only the template, comments and closes it as not planned.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.name: CI gates and build
.github/workflows/ci.yml.description: On push or PR to master, main or fumadocs: runs audit, types, tests, every content gate and lint, then builds and smoke-tests the served site.

.github/workflows/faq-refresh.yml.name: FAQ refresh
.github/workflows/faq-refresh.yml.description: Mondays 08:00 UTC or by hand: fetches the Notion FAQ rows with NOTION_TOKEN, regenerates the partials and opens a PR when anything changed.

.github/workflows/gas-target-refresh.yml.name: Gas-target refresh
.github/workflows/gas-target-refresh.yml.description: Mondays 08:00 UTC or by hand: reads ArbGasInfo over the public RPCs, regenerates the gas-target partial and opens a PR on change.

.github/workflows/merge-controlled.yml.name: Merge-controlled label gate
.github/workflows/merge-controlled.yml.description: Fails the PR check while the merge-controlled label is present, re-running on label changes; blocks only once made a required check.

.github/workflows/nitro-bump.yml.name: Nitro bump
.github/workflows/nitro-bump.yml.description: Manual dispatch with a release tag: runs nitro:check-release --to, regenerates precompile tables and the CLI page, and opens the bump PR.

.github/workflows/sbom-export.yaml.name: SBOM export
.github/workflows/sbom-export.yaml.description: On push to master and Tuesdays: builds a CycloneDX SBOM from pnpm-lock.yaml with cdxgen and uploads it to Dependency-Track; skips without secrets.

.github/workflows/upstream-refresh.yml.name: Upstream refresh
.github/workflows/upstream-refresh.yml.description: Mondays 08:00 UTC: checks the pinned Nitro release, PRs regenerated precompile tables, and opens a 'Nitro vX.Y.Z is available' issue when one exists.
